buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original

delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1) INTERESTED BIDDERS MUST HAVE TO UPLOAD A CERTIFICATE OF ATC IN R/O ACCEPTING ALL THE TER M AND CONDITIONS OF THIS BID. BID WITHOUT SUBMISSION OF SAME CAN BE SUMMARILY REJECTED IN TE C HNICAL EVALUATION BY BOO. 2) ADDITIONAL SPECIFICATION OF SUGAR REQUIRED BY THIS UNIT A. COLOUR OF SUGAR IS SHINING WHITE AND MEDIUM GRANULE IN SIZES. 5 / 7 B. PACKING OF SUGAR BAG IS OF 50 KGS. C. LIFE OF SUGAR MUST BE OF 02 YRS FROM THE DATE OF SUPPLY. D. SUGAR MUST BE MOISTURE FREE. E. DATE OF MANUFACTURING AND DATE OF EXPIRY WILL BE PRINTED ON EACH PACK OF SUGAR. F. MRP ALSO BE PRINTED ON EACH BAGS OF SUGAR. G. QUOTED RATES MUST BE LESSER THAN MRP. IF THERE IS ANY DISCREPANCY FOUND IN THE SUPPLIED Q TY, THEN WHOLE SUPPLY CAN BE REJECTED BY BOO AT THE TIME OF LINE COMMITTEE. 3) INTERESTED BIDDERS MUST HAVE TO SUBMIT A HARDCOPY OF EMD ON OR BEFORE BID END DATE. BID WITHOUT SUBMISSION OF SAME CAN BE SUMMARILY REJECTED IN TECHNICAL EVALUATION BY BOO. IN PU RSUANCE OF THIS, SUCCESSIVE BIDDERS MUST HAVE TO DEPOSIT A EPBG ON TIME AND MUST HAVE TO M ADE A SUPPLY AS PER STAGERRED SCHEDULE. 4) INTERESTED BIDDERS MUST HAVE TO UPLOAD A DESIRED DOCUMENTS FOR TECHNICAL EVALUATION. B ID WITHOUT SUBMISSION OF SAME BY ANY BIDDER CAN BE SUMMARILY REJECTED IN TECHNCIAL EVALUATI ON BY BOO. 5) INTERESTED BIDDERS MUST HAVE TO SUBMIT LATEST PROOF OF EXPERIENCE AND TURNOVER IN SAME CATEGORY WITH CERTIFICATE OF SATISFACTORY SUPPLY DURING SAID DURATION DULY ISSUED FROM CO MPETENT AUTHORITY OF SAID ORGANIZATION. BID WITHOUT SUBMISSION OF SAME CAN BE SUMMARILY R EJECTED IN TECHNICAL EVALUATION. 6) DUE TO ADMINISTRATIVE OR OTHER REASONS, COMPETENT AUTHORITY RESERVES A RIGHT TO CANCEL THE BID AT ANY STAGE WITHOUT GIVING ANY FURTHER INFORMATION TO ANY BIDDER. 7) SELLER HAVE TO SUBMIT EMD @ Rs- 24000/- IN FORM OF DD IN FAVOUR OF COMMANDANT 47TH BN, IT BP IN SBI SAMBA. 8) SELLER HAVE TO SUBMIT LATEST UPDATED MSME CERTIFICATE, IF SELLER WANT TO TAKE BENIFIT (EXE MPTION IN YEAR OF EXPERIENCE AND TURNOVER AND EXEMPTION TO DEPOSIT EMD)
